Message.MsgText: The starting directory path is not specified.

Explanation.p: The 'Directory Path' parameter in the configuration of the Connector is not set.

OperatorResponse.p: Set the 'Directory Path' parameter in the configuration of the Connector.

Message.MsgText: The depth parameter can not be negative.

Explanation.p: The 'Depth' parameter is a negative number.

OperatorResponse.p: Either leave the 'Depth' parameter blank or provide a non-negative value.

Message.MsgText: The glob pattern 'glob pattern' is invalid.

Explanation.p: The given filter is not a correct glob pattern.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the documentation of the Connector and modify the filter so that it matches the glob syntax.

Message.MsgText: Full Path 'full path' criteria is used. Connector will skip Lookup and use the specified file or directory directly.

Explanation.p: The specified file is Read-Only and cannot be deleted without the 'Force Delete' option.

OperatorResponse.p: Enable the 'Force Delete' option in the configuration of the Connector.

Explanation.p: The specified directory is not empty and cannot be deleted without the 'Force Delete' option.

OperatorResponse.p: Enable the 'Force Delete' option in the configuration of the Connector.

Message.MsgText: The name of the file or directory is not specified. At least the 'fullPath' or 'name' attribute must be provided in the Output Map.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide the 'fullPath' or 'name' attribute in the Output Map.
